text:
Ellen R.: Partner SI requested marketplace compliance packet for their listing: SOC2 PDF, pen-test one-pager, supply-chain questionnaire, and an HSM attestation. They want presigned links and a brief exec summary by EOD Fri.

Marc P. (sec): Redaction rules first: remove IPs/internal hostnames, redact serial numbers, remove customer IDs, replace raw vuln dumps with public advisory links, and summarize high CVSS items as "addressed" with mitigation date.

June L. (legal): I'll need to review the attestation and questionnaire before signing. No marketing claims in the cover letter; stick to factual statements.

Hao T. (infra): Upload plan: originals -> s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/inbound/si-esp/ ; outbound redacted bundle -> /outbound/si-esp/. Include README.txt listing redactions and a sha256 checksum.

Ellen R.: Partner asked for 14-day presign TTL. Is that OK?

Marc P. (sec): 14 days fine for hardware/SI. Security signoff required before presign. Also require an integrity note: who generated the link and TTL.

doc-bot: Reminder set: "Compliance bundle due EOD Fri" at 2026-08-14 17:00.

Hao T. (infra): I'll run the presign command after signoff: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/outbound/si-esp/si-compliance-bundle.zip --expires-in 1209600`

Ellen R.: Action items: Hao upload originals by Thu noon; Marc redaction review Thu 15:00; June sign Fri 10:00; Hao presign Fri 11:00; Ellen send to partner Fri 12:00.

Marc P. (sec): Uploaded redaction notes to inbound/redaction_notes.md. Two items to sanitize (internal ticket refs).

Hao T. (infra): Redacted bundle v1 uploaded to outbound and sha256.txt present.

June L. (legal): Reviewed and signed cover letter. Files moved to outbound.

Marc P. (sec): Security signoff complete. No raw exploit details remain.

Hao T. (infra): Presigned link created: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketplace-artifacts/outbound/si-esp/si-compliance-bundle-v1.zip?X-Amz-Expires=1209600

Ellen R.: Sent to partner and logged exchange in marketplace tracker (row 87). Set outbound retention=60 days and internal archival retained.

June L. (legal): If partner requests longer retention or wider distribution, escalate to legal.

Marc P. (sec): We'll add this flow as a short checklist in the partnerships playbook (redaction rules + presign TTL).

Ellen R.: Thanks all 44d. Closing thread unless follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
